old_problem: A final enumerated PCIe link cannot prove the intended function entered D3hot or D3cold, that the correct power resource changed, or that wake restored enumeration, driver and GPU function within deadline. The D3 variant, shared-resource blast radius, iterations and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row unambiguously targets D3 power management through NVQual Test #31. D3hot versus D3cold, exact PCI function and shared power-resource topology, quiesce/entry/wake method, latency, iterations and recovery are runtime Project Configuration. They can close the execution gate without keeping the review Pending, while D3 remains distinct from L1, retrain, reboot and platform power cycle.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2134, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2135 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00012-V002 / 1507ffaba5cbcae5 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned Test #31 revision, target PCI function/GPU and sibling/shared-power topology, supported D3 variant and all consumers before any state change.
For each cycle prove quiesce, initial state, exact D3 state/resource condition, approved wake, re-enumeration/link/driver/GPU restoration and measured latency.
Preserve/hash preexisting logs and inventories; the source instruction to clear logs cannot erase baseline or first-fault evidence.
Retain the 300-minute source coverage and signed iterations; D3hot cannot substitute for D3cold, and L1/retrain/rebind/reboot/power cycle cannot substitute for D3 coverage.
Stop on wrong resource, sibling loss, failed entry/wake, late or incomplete restoration, downtraining, driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot, disqualifying AER or evidence gap; never retry automatically.
No NVQual/D3 change, unbind/rebind, link/device query, log clearing, reset, reboot, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Function-and-resource-bound HGX NVQual Test #31 PCIe D3 power management
test_case.purpose: Prove every approved target function enters the specified D3 state and wakes to complete enumeration, link, driver and GPU functional health within deadline without affecting out-of-scope resources, hanging or rebooting the host, or creating disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #31 D3 configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed PCI function/root-port/switch/endpoint/GPU/sibling and shared power-resource map
Approved D3hot or D3cold target, consumer quiesce, entry method, wake source and restoration-latency oracle
Signed iterations/timing, enumeration/link/driver/function/error and final-policy acceptance
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, durable transaction ledger, BMC/console and mode-specific recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash baseline D-state, topology, inventories, policies and logs. Run only the pinned Test #31 target transaction; for each cycle record quiesce, active start, exact D3/resource state, wake request, latency, complete re-enumeration, required generation/width, stable NVIDIA identities, driver/GPU function and error deltas before another cycle. Stop on first anomaly; do not force rebind, reset, power-cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every configured target enters the signed D3 variant without unintended sibling/resource impact and wakes by deadline with complete expected enumeration, link state, driver and GPU functionality; all Test #31 items complete for 300 minutes with no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until D3 variant, function/resource scope, quiesce/wake/restoration oracle and iterations are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted transaction. FAIL on wrong/failed entry, unintended resource loss, late/failed wake, missing/misbound device, downtraining, driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot or disqualifying error. Missing inputs/artifacts are BLOCKED; forced rebind or later recovery cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact target, D3 variant, shared-resource scope, quiesce/entry/wake/latency contract, iterations and recovery are signed.
Verify consumers are idle and preserve baseline state/evidence before any D-state or power-resource change.
Use an isolated SUT with console; D3cold/shared-power operations require explicit point authorization.
Stop without rebind/reset/power escalation or automatic retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #31 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus target/sibling/link/power-resource topology and supported D states
Complete PCI power/link/AER/NVIDIA/kernel/BMC/SEL/console/thermal/power artifacts and baseline hashes
First-fault recovery or clean restored policy/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At wrong-resource effect, failed entry/wake, sibling or target loss, incomplete/late restoration, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or evidence gap, inhibit later cycles and preserve the first event. Do not force bind/reset/power automatically; follow the signed D3-variant recovery and quarantine if expected topology/function is not restored.
